source_class: Official NRL Finals Week 1 team list and official NRL.com player profiles
rule: Raw profile facts remain separate from MAYHEM inference. Unpublished fields are FIELD_NOT_PUBLISHED. Derived trends use genuine per-round rows and do not establish causation.

players.trend_note: Official per-round rows show 80 minutes at fullback in each of Rounds 13, 14, 16 and 17; running metres 115, 170, 171 and 164 respectively. Role continuity is verified. Statistics alone do not establish causation.
players.team_effect: Role-critical fullback baseline enriched; no standalone confidence change.

players.trend_note: Official rows show winger minutes of 74, 80, 49 and 60 across Rounds 19, 20, 21 and 27, with running metres 204, 173, 81 and 107 and tries 3, 1, 0 and 1. Workload variation is retained without causal inference.
players.team_effect: Experienced starting-wing baseline enriched; no standalone confidence change.

players.trend_note: Official rows show 80 minutes at hooker in Rounds 23-26. Tackles made were 36, 55, 46 and 60; running metres 67, 41, 76 and 70. Defensive workload and role continuity are verified; no causal explanation is inferred.
players.team_effect: Role-critical hooker workload baseline enriched; no standalone confidence change.

players.trend_note: Official rows show prop minutes of 61, 63, 44 and 46 across Rounds 1-4 with running metres 49, 149, 68 and 112. This is a historical workload sample only; no causal inference is made.
players.team_effect: Starting-prop statistical baseline enriched; no standalone confidence change.

decision_effect: Roosters reconciliation advances 0/22 to 4/22. Role-critical fullback and hooker data materially improve player-layer completeness but do not justify a Panthers/Roosters confidence change by themselves.
